change: LFM2.5-24B-A2B (off, on) and Qwen3.8 Flash (off) matches voided and replayed from scratch with the same seeds (letter readout fix)
reason: The answer letter readout (letter_readout "answer") read letter probabilities at the first single-letter token of the response's logprobs. Liquid AI's API returns logprobs for the reasoning tokens too, so every LFM2.5 decision read a letter from the reasoning text (off: the 16-token budget ended inside the reasoning, no answer at all; on: 88 of 101 sampled decisions read a different letter than the model answered). For Qwen3.8 Flash (off) via OpenRouter/Alibaba, 145 of 930 decisions read the lowercase c of a "choice" key split into c/ho/ice. The runner now reads the last uppercase single-letter token that ends the reply and counts a mismatch with the reply's letter as invalid (74d74c7). Audit of the other answer-readout setups: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (off, on) and GLM-5.3 (on) via Fireworks and Qwen3.8-27B via Cerebras read the reply's letter in every sampled decision.
